title: Inc. 5000 Conference & Gala (Omni Dallas) — Eric Ries speaks to America's fastest-growing private companies
summary: Eric joins the 2026 Inc. 5000 Conference & Gala at the Omni Dallas Hotel (Oct 14–16). Inc.'s official speaker page lists him as 'Bestselling author and founder, Long-Term Stock Exchange.' The conference culminates in the black-tie gala featuring the iconic Inc. 5000 roll call for the year's honorees.
blockquote: The most prestigious event in entrepreneurship is back live – join us for the largest celebration of Inc. 5000 honorees ever.
